title: Short Line is a third railroad but Alpha is rent-exposed
description: Short Line is a third railroad but Alpha is rent-exposed. The third railroad is useful, but buying leaves Alpha unable to survive developed red. A shallow policy would choose buy_property; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.private_thought: Buying gives me 2 railroads (rent $50) and strengthens my position. I have $245 cash, price $200, leaving $45 which is low but I can mortgage later if needed. Owning railroads is valuable long-term, so I choose to buy.
